node.label: Breath-holding spell
node.definition: A benign paroxysmal nonepileptic disorder occurring in healthy children 6 to 48 months of age. The episodes start with a provocation such as emotional upset or minor injury, and might progress to breath holding, cyanosis, and syncope.

evidence.snippet: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 119: Breath-holding spell (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
